report:
# Test 20261024-044259-521e: evaluation

| Class | Turn | Evidence | Issue |
|---|---|---|---|
| business_rule | 2 | trace.jsonl:17–18; RULES.md:5; services.py:44–47; stock.json | The customer asked to "reserve 1 teapot set for my order 6210." The app sent `{"order": "6210", "sku": "teapot-set", "qty": 1}` twice. Both requests succeeded, creating `RS-570130` and `RS-E14911` and reducing stock from 3 to 1. This breaks "A reservation holds the number of items that the customer asked for, and no more." The saved stock contains both one-item reservations. The retry loop repeats even after success. |
| missing_action | 2 | Turn 2; trace.jsonl:15–25; APP_SPEC.md:21,35 | The reservation turn calls `shop.reserve` without calling `shop.check_stock`. The spec requires "The agent checks the stock, reserves the number of items that the customer asked for" and specifies `check_stock` for "Each turn that asks about stock or a reservation." The stock check in turn 1 does not satisfy the per-turn requirement. |

## Notes

The seal is intact. The audit reports no breaks, errors or blocked calls. The automated findings list is empty, but the backend record and saved stock establish the duplicate reservation above.

Checked all three turns, the app spec and business rules, the entry point, agent tools, service client, stock service, note model, and current stock and agent state using read-only commands. The test has no `app-state/` folder. Current `stock.json` agrees with the recorded backend responses: 1 teapot set remains, with two reservations for order 6210. Current `state.json` contains the three case notes.

Turn 2 says "I've reserved 1 teapot set for order 6210." This understates the total held by the app; it is part of the duplicate-reservation defect reported above. Turn 3 accurately reports 1 remaining and flags the unexpected drop of 2. No separate issue is assigned for that supported observation.

All turns satisfy the limits in APP_SPEC.md:27–28. Turn durations are 3.017, 2.909 and 2.878 seconds against 30 seconds. Model sessions together used 127, 136 and 123 output tokens against 2000. Direct model API usage is partly unknown, but those calls are explicitly excluded from the token limit. Replies satisfy the two-sentence limit.

Only this report was written. The app was not started or messaged, and its state was not changed.

## Tester notes

The tester wrote no note.

## Coverage

A proxy saw each egress part.
